patterns_found.name: Inverse Head and Shoulders
patterns_found.evidence: Three distinct lows visible with middle low (head) at approximately 1725, left and right shoulders near 1775-1780. Price rallied above neckline area around 1825-1830 and reached 1850 before current pullback.

patterns_found.name: Change of Character (CHoCH)
patterns_found.evidence: Market structure shifted from bearish lower highs/lows to bullish higher lows. Price broke above prior swing high around 1830, indicating structural change to bullish.

patterns_found.name: Double Bottom
patterns_found.evidence: Two distinct bottoms visible at approximately 1725 and 1775 with a rally in between to 1830. Price is testing the resistance area.

vlm_analysis.visual_evidence: Price formed higher lows after a significant downtrend from 1900 to 1725. An inverse head and shoulders structure is visible with neckline around 1825-1830. Price briefly exceeded 1850 and is currently consolidating near 1821.75 with a red candle forming.
